summary: UUID() calls in query handlers cause non-deterministic values for subsequent UUID() calls in workflow code during replay, breaking workflow determinism.
userImpact: Workflows using UUID generation in query handlers will fail during replay due to non-deterministic UUID values, causing workflow execution failures.
rootCause: UUID() function calls in query handlers are not properly isolated from the deterministic random number generator used during replay, causing subsequent workflow UUID calls to produce different values.
keyQuote: Using uuid() in query handlers (or validate update) can cause subsequent calls to uuid() in the workflow code to produce non-deterministic values.
